description: In every nonempty expanded structure, the specified native universal closure of \(A\) holds if and only if \(A\) holds under every natural-number-variable assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.universalClosure_truth.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type z}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N] [Nonempty N]
  (A : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Formula ℕ) :
  N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.universalClosure A ↔ ∀ (v : ℕ → N), A.Realize v
